title.original: PROMPTEVALS: A Dataset of Assertions and Guardrails for Custom Production Large Language Model Pipelines
title.zh: PROMPTEVALS：面向定制化生产 LLM 流水线的断言与护栏数据集
title.en: PROMPTEVALS: A Dataset of Assertions and Guardrails for Custom Production Large Language Model Pipelines

inclusion_reason.zh: PROMPTEVALS 把生产提示与可执行断言配对，为 guardrail 生成、比较和流水线旁路验证提供公共评测基础。
inclusion_reason.en: PROMPTEVALS pairs production prompts with executable assertions, creating reusable evaluation infrastructure for guardrail generation, comparison, and pipeline-side validation.

abstract.zh: PROMPTEVALS 汇集生产 LLM 数据流水线中的提示及其开发者定义断言，用于研究如何自动生成贴合任务要求的 guardrail。数据来自开源流水线工具的真实使用场景，连接了提示工程、可靠性检查与生产评测。
abstract.en: PROMPTEVALS pairs production LLM-pipeline prompts with developer-authored assertions for studying automatic guardrail generation. Drawn from real use of open-source pipeline tools, it links prompt requirements to executable reliability checks.

problem.zh: 定制 LLM 流水线常在批量生产输入上偏离指令，但开发者难以系统地写出覆盖真实需求的输出断言与护栏。
problem.en: Custom LLM pipelines often violate instructions at production scale, yet developers lack a systematic way to derive output assertions that capture the task's actual requirements.

approach.zh: 作者从开发者工具中整理提示—断言配对，划分保留测试集，并比较闭源、开源及针对该任务微调的模型生成相关断言的能力。
approach.en: The authors curate prompt–assertion pairs from developer tooling, create a held-out benchmark split, and compare proprietary, open, and task-fine-tuned models on assertion generation.

system_design.zh: 数据契约将每条生产提示关联到一组可执行断言标准，支持训练断言生成器、离线比较候选 guardrail，并将选中的检查嵌入流水线旁路运行。
system_design.en: Its data contract associates each production prompt with executable assertion criteria, enabling assertion-generator training, offline guardrail comparison, and eventual sidecar checks beside a pipeline.

key_results.zh: 在保留集上，面向 PROMPTEVALS 微调的 Mistral 与 Llama 3 模型被报告在断言相关性上优于 GPT-4o，同时具有更低时延。
key_results.en: On the held-out split, Mistral and Llama 3 models fine-tuned for PROMPTEVALS are reported to generate more relevant assertions than GPT-4o with lower latency.

limitations.zh: 数据来源于特定开源工具的自选择开发者，断言相关性不等同于线上故障拦截率；跨行业覆盖、误报成本和 guardrail 漂移仍需生产验证。
limitations.en: The corpus reflects self-selected users of particular tools, and assertion relevance is not the same as online failure prevention; domain coverage, false-positive cost, and guardrail drift need production validation.

notes.zh: 数据规模、具名模型、GPT-4o 基线和平均改进来自官方摘要；评分定义、领域分布、硬件与时延数值待全文审计。
notes.en: Dataset scale, named models, the GPT-4o baseline, and average improvement come from the official abstract; scoring, domain mix, hardware, and latency values await full-text audit.
